title: Update authenticated-DIO integration fixtures for signer-bound source validation
description: python/tests/test_vectors.py still constructs authenticated DIO IPv6 sources as fe80::1 or another fixed IID while LinkLayer now correctly requires the link-authenticated sender's key-derived IID. This causes 33 production-conformance/vector integration failures across rule-version and SCHC fragmentation tests. Update the shared DIO fixture/oracle to derive the source from the signing peer and preserve independent expected bytes; verify all test_vectors cases.
